decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extension  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 6 The Close.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the siude walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 8 - The hardstanding hereby permitted shall either be made of porous materials, or provision shall be made to direct run-off water from the hardstanding to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the dwellinghouse.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension and front hardstanding with new means of access
